title: Palm Boulevard #3700 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the home is designed for comfort and style, featuring cozy furnishings and an updated kitchen equipped with modern appliances, including a gas range—ideal for crafting delicious meals. The second-floor primary suite is a true sanctuary, opening onto the top-floor oceanview porch where you can savor your morning coffee or unwind with an evening glass of wine. Located just a short drive from historic Charleston, this beach house blends the serene ambiance of a seaside escape with convenient access to world-class dining and cultural experiences, making it the perfect destination for your next beachfront getaway. Our family had a great week at this Sullivan’s Island beach house. The location was perfect for making memories—cooking meals in the well-equipped kitchen, eating on the porch with ocean views, and searching for shells at sunrise. The private boardwalk made beach access easy, and the hammock was a great spot to relax.Being close to restaurants like Home Team BBQ, Poe’s Tavern, and The Longboard was a plus. The house was comfortable, spacious, and had everything we needed. If you’re looking for a true oceanfront stay with great amenities, this is a solid choice.
